text: {"final": {"summary": "In inventory/stock.py, reserve_stock now validates warehouse_id first: it imports is_valid_warehouse_id from core.ids and raises ValueError(f\"malformed warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\") for codes not matching the WH-RRR-NN format (e.g. 'WH7'). The check runs before load_ledger, so nothing is recorded in the ledger when a code is rejected; valid codes like 'WH-HGL-07' pass through unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
